description:
Deep Calm | Santoor Instrumental | 3 Hours of Peaceful Rest

Maybe you're closing out a long day. Maybe the week has only just begun and your mind is already running ahead of you. Either way — this is a soft place to land.

This peaceful Indian ambient meditation music is designed to slow a busy mind and settle the body, whether you're winding down the evening or easing into a new day.

Enjoy 3 hours of gentle santoor melodies blended with a warm tanpura drone and soft ambient textures — slow, shimmering strings with long fading notes and no sudden changes.

Perfect for unwinding after a long day, slow mornings, meditation, reading, gentle yoga, resting, journaling, quiet evenings, background calm at home, or simply sitting still.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Santoor — hammered strings with a soft, shimmering, bell-like tone
Raga: Bhairavi — the gentle 'any-hour' raga, traditionally played to close a concert
Style: Slow Indian classical ambient
Mood: Deeply calm, unhurried, reassuring
Atmosphere: Warm, spacious, softly glowing
Duration: 3 hours, uninterrupted

🎧 HOW TO USE
Press play, set the volume low, and let it stay on in the background. There's nothing to follow and nothing to do — let the music set the pace and take it slow.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00  A soft place to land
0:20  Letting the week loosen
0:40  Slow shimmering stillness
1:00  Deep calm settles in
1:20  Nothing left to do
1:40  Resting without effort
2:00  Peace of mind returns
2:20  Quiet inner spaciousness
2:40  Drifting gently onward
2:55  Gentle fade into silence

⏱ BEST FOR
Evening wind-down
A calm, unhurried start to the week
Deep relaxation after a heavy day
Meditation and breathwork
Quiet reading or journaling
Gentle yoga or stretching
Background calm for the whole room
Settling an overactive mind
Rest without needing to sleep
Slowing down when everything feels rushed

If this music helped you slow down and find some peace of mind, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian ambient healing music.
